Dead City roster

Notes save on this device as you type.

52 monsters in Kaiju Madness (51 originals, renamed and redesigned, with the old name under each, plus Mike) and 8 Tornado Alley storms at the bottom. Each casts one spell per size: Hatchling, Titan, Colossus. Tell me changes by number or id.

    MEGA A bright glowing green nuke. Round end A black chopper bursts out of the street and he rides off.

    Skeleton: bone-white with a flaming skullHalloween: his normal outfit plus a pink tutu and a long blond wig

Tornado Alley storms (8)

Every storm skin. Your lightning (tap or SPACE) takes the skin's colours. Win one in TOTAL DESTRUCTION or a prize chest and it goes straight on; switch any time from the pause menu.

  • T1. DEFAULT STORM storm · id: stormdefault
    Free

    The classic grey funnel with blue-white lightning.

  • T2. HALLOWSTORM storm · id: stormhalloween
    2 coins

    Black funnel, bats and jack-o-lanterns, green, purple and orange lights.

  • T3. BLIZZARD storm · id: stormchristmas
    2 coins

    White and snowing, with reindeer and snowmen; red and green lightning.

  • T4. FIRENADO storm · id: stormfire
    2 coins

    A column of fire, embers and red lightning.

  • T5. SHARKNADO storm · id: stormshark
    2 coins

    A spinning waterspout full of sharks.

  • T6. BUNNYNADO storm · id: stormeaster
    2 coins

    Pastel swirls, bunnies and eggs; pink lightning.

  • T7. ACID STORM storm · id: stormacid
    Bonus: beat Megacity

    Toxic green funnel, acid rain, bright green lightning, and baby tornadoes that spin off, circle you and roam the town.

  • T8. LIBERTY TWISTER storm · id: stormjuly4
    2 coins

    A dark funnel wrapped in spinning neon red and blue rings, flags flying, fireworks bursting out.
